headword: {海外出張|かいがいしゅっちょう}
reading: かいがいしゅっちょう

examples.japanese: {来月|らいげつ}{海外出張|かいがいしゅっちょう}がある。
examples.english: I have an overseas business trip next month.

examples.japanese: {海外出張|かいがいしゅっちょう}の{準備|じゅんび}でパスポートを{更新|こうしん}した。
examples.english: I renewed my passport in preparation for an overseas business trip.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{年|ねん}に{数回|すうかい}{海外出張|かいがいしゅっちょう}があり、{主|おも}にアジアの{取引先|とりひきさき}を{訪問|ほうもん}している。
examples.english: He has several overseas business trips per year, mainly visiting clients in Asia.

notes:
A compound of {海外|かいがい} (overseas) and {出張|しゅっちょう} (business trip). Very common in corporate settings where international business is involved.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {海外出張|かいがいしゅっちょう}に{行|い}く: to go on an overseas business trip
- {海外出張|かいがいしゅっちょう}{費|ひ}: overseas business travel expenses
- {海外出張|かいがいしゅっちょう}{報告書|ほうこくしょ}: overseas trip report
- {海外出張|かいがいしゅっちょう}{手当|てあて}: overseas travel allowance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {出張|しゅっちょう}: business trip — the general term; can be domestic or international
- {海外赴任|かいがいふにん}: overseas posting — a long-term assignment abroad, not a short trip
- {海外旅行|かいがいりょこう}: overseas travel — for leisure, not business
